title: Three Billy Goats Gruff
rating_justification: Target rating G applied (recommended: PG). While the story is a fantasy/steampunk retelling of a fable, it contains descriptions of violence and physical harm that exceed a 'G' rating. The Automaton threatens to 'dismantle' characters for 'flesh and bone,' and the climax involves 'piercing sensors' and 'cracking hulls.' The imagery of a monster demanding a toll of flesh and the visceral description of the machine's destruction are more appropriate for a PG audience.
